agent_boundary.cwd: One isolated read-only source packet containing only the assigned immutable binding, source snapshots, diff, prompt, and frozen policies

allowed: bounded read-only inspection inside the assigned source packet
repository-local path and text search inside the packet
returning exactly one review or adjudication artifact to supervisor escrow
forbidden: bash, shell, write, edit, web, browser, network, or arbitrary command tools
network access except the model provider control-plane used by the supervisor
clone, fetch, pull, or lazy object retrieval during review
dependency installation, build, tests, hooks, submodules, or LFS
containers, services, runtime introspection, or VM execution
reading predictions, scores, route census, vendor output, prior labels, or another lane before custody permits it
writing custody, telemetry, transcript, policy, source, review, or adjudication files
provider_control_plane_exception: Only the supervisor-to-provider model API transport is permitted; it cannot be used by the child as a source/network tool.
